name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The 'Tsvetanka Hristova' tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria's greatest athletes. The competition is organized for the 17th time and includes the second round of the youth athletics series 'A1 Athletics for Youth'. The tournament takes place at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and gathers athletes of various ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors the legacy of Tsvetanka Hristova and encourages the development of young talents.
course_highlights: Held at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia
Includes the second round of the 'A1 Athletics for Youth' series
Memorial tournament in honor of Olympic medalist Tsvetanka Hristova
additional: athletics competitions, youth rounds, memorial tournament

name: Асеновградски Баири
description: Asenovgrad Bairi is a competition and festival that combines sport and entertainment in the nature of Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event includes mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, allowing participants and guests to enjoy the nature and sights of the region. Organized by the Association "ASENOVGRADSKI BAIRI", the competition offers various distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and levels of fitness. Participation requires good physical condition and appropriate equipment, and the event is aimed at sports and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with control points and time limits for long distances
Running and cycling disciplines on two separate days
Opportunity to visit sights and evening entertainment between the days
additional: The competition includes children's starts on short distances, control times, and stops at certain kilometers for the long runs (47 km and 80 km). For cycling, there are different distances from 0.5 km to 60 km. The event takes place at the square "Acad. N. Haitov" in Asenovgrad. Participants should be prepared for mountain conditions and risks, including fatigue and bad weather. The disciplines include mountain running and cycling with various distances; the competition has participation regulations, including equipment and physical preparation; online registration is available, and there are different categories for participants.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National Championship for 10,000 meters on track in Hisarya is a prestigious race organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. This championship brings together the best Bulgarian athletes competing in the classic 10-kilometer track distance. The event is part of the federation's sports calendar for 2026 and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.
course_highlights: Track race with a classic distance of 10,000 meters
Held in the city of Hisarya
Part of the national sports calendar of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: The first national championship in Hisarya for 10,000 meters on track is included in the sports calendar for 2026.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that combines sports with a social cause, supporting youth sports and shelters without cages. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances with varying difficulty - from 1 km to a half marathon of 21 km. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while having fun with music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social contacts.
course_highlights: Terrain 50% asphalt and 50% park alleys with gravel
Checkpoints at different kilometers depending on the distance
Festival village with interactive tents and music
additional: Start number distribution will be held from April 21 to 23, from 9:00 to 19:00 in the South wing of the rectorate. Each distance has an official warm-up and an award ceremony. Games, raffles, and opportunities for social contacts and professional feedback are included. Official T-shirts and other merchandise with a cause to support youth sports. Distances: 1 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km; support for social causes such as helping children with cerebral palsy and animals; an event with an active community and numerous prizes.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is the largest spring mountain running event in Bulgaria, held near Lake Pancharevo. The race offers three distances - 42 km marathon with 1700 meters of elevation gain, 21 km half marathon with 700 meters of elevation gain to Bachun Peak, and 10 km suitable for beginners, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The routes pass through the picturesque Lozenska Mountain with views of Vitosha, Stara Planina, Rila, and the Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by the sports club "Begach" and attracts more participants each year.
course_highlights: 42 km marathon with 1700 m elevation gain through Lozenska Mountain
21 km half marathon with 700 m elevation gain to Bachun Peak
10 km routes with about 100 m elevation change, suitable for beginners
additional: Start packages are collected on Thursday and Friday before the race in Sofia. Support stations and medical assistance are available along the routes. The event does not provide cups; participants must bring their own bottle or cup for water. A wardrobe is available, but organizers are not responsible for lost items. Free parking is available in Pancharevo. Medical teams are present at the start, Pasarel, and Lalina Mogila. Participants must wear a bib on the chest or stomach. Multiple race categories, including mountain running and hikes; an event focused on nature and social activities; date April 26, 2026.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race from the XLkmrun calendar, taking place in the foothills of the Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is in the shape of an eight, starting from the northern outskirts of Bankya and leading to the Ostra Chuka peak. Participants can choose between two distances - 6.4 km with 217 meters of positive elevation gain or 12.8 km, with the course offering challenges for mountain running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: The course is in the shape of an eight starting from the northern outskirts of Bankya
Per lap length of 6.4 km with 217 meters of positive elevation gain
Option to choose between one or two laps (6.4 km or 12.8 km)
additional: The course is the idea of Miroslav Spasov. The race is organized at the location of the spring relay. Part of the 5kmrun calendar with other events in Sofia and the country. Race in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain, date 2026-04-26

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a picturesque and challenging race that starts from the village of Bistritsa, accessible by public transport. The course passes through diverse terrain with smooth but demanding ascents, reaching the Kikiš area with panoramic views of Sofia. The route continues to the Kamен del hut, where participants can refresh themselves with food and drinks. This race is an excellent training for strength and endurance, suitable for preparing for long distances and mountain running.
course_highlights: Start from the village of Bistritsa with easy access by bus №98
Smooth but demanding ascent with 500 m positive elevation to the Kikiš area
Panoramic views of Sofia and the opportunity for rest and support at the Kamен del hut
additional: The route includes a variety of surfaces - from forest trails to rocky sections, which helps adaptation to different conditions. In the Kikiš shelter area, shelter and food are available on weekends. Running in nature provides recovery away from city noise. terrain, marathon preparation, natural environment

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване за мъже и жени и юноши и девойки под 20 г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship - uphill for men, women, juniors, and under 20s will be held on April 26, 2026, in Sofia, Bistritsa village. The event is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and offers a challenging mountain run with an uphill course, suitable for various age groups. Organizers provide official registration and support for the competitors, with communication conducted directly with them. The event is traditional and attracts athletes seeking a competitive experience in mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain running with uphill course in the Bistritsa village area, Sofia
Race for men, women, juniors, and under 20s
Held under the auspices of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: Contact with the organizer is recommended for all inquiries. The race is part of the national mountain running championship and takes place in Bistritsa village, Sofia. It is part of the national mountain running series with a focus on uphill running, providing opportunities for participation across different age groups.

name: 10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
location: Парк „Св. Св. Петър и Павел“, София, България
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy Race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria, held at St. Peter and Paul Park. The race takes place on a 785-meter flat, certified asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the maximum distance within 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of organizers and fellow runners.
course_highlights: 785-meter flat, certified asphalt loop
Held at St. Peter and Paul Park in Sofia
Minimum daily distance of 43.44 km (27 miles)
additional: Every day of the race starts at 8:00 AM. Each participant wears a visible race number at the front. Laps are counted by a judge who changes every six hours. There is also a backup camera system for counting. If a participant interrupts the race or leaves the track, they must inform the judge. It is possible to count a "hotel lap" when leaving and returning to the track at certain points. Consumption of alcohol, smoking, and drug use are prohibited within the camp and on the track. There is a minimum dress code for running and in the park, prohibiting running without upper clothing. Official results are published the next day around 9:00 AM on www.srichinmoyraces.bg. Terrain: asphalt track, 785 m; registration until April 1, 2026; personal helper fee 35 euros/day; vegetarian meals and medical assistance included.

description: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Easter Marathon 2026 is a sports event in Stara Zagora, which includes mountain running and mountain biking. Organized by the Non-Profit Association Cycling and Tourism Club "Zarata" with the support of the Municipality of Stara Zagora and the Tourist Association "Sarnena Gora", the competition offers various distances for running and cycling in Ayazmo Park. Participants must have valid insurance and sign a liability waiver. The event begins with registration and briefing from 07:00 to 08:00, and the awards ceremony is at 17:00.
course_highlights: Mountain running and mountain biking in Ayazmo Park
Running distances: 5 km, 11 km, 21 km, 32 km, and 38 km (ultra)
Cycling with eBike MTB up to 27 km/h on the 38 km ultra trail
additional: Registration and distribution of start numbers from 07:00 to 08:00. Mandatory helmet use for cyclists. Payment is only via bank transfer or at EasyPay cash desks after online registration. Participants must have valid accident insurance for the day of the event (except UCI cardholders). Awards at 17:00 for both disciplines. Cycling routes will include approximately 32 km hobby trail and 42 km ultra trail; online registration, bank transfer payment; requirement for valid insurance and wearing a helmet for cyclists.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring distances of 5 and 10 kilometers, as well as a 1 km children's run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, emotions, and a charitable cause, with 40% of the entry fees donated to charity. The route is flat, suitable for all levels, and passes through the most beautiful parts of the park with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized route with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere with prizes and sports demonstrations.
course_highlights: Flat route suitable for all levels
Passes along the Maritsa River and relaxation zones with water views
10 km route consists of 2 laps around the park
additional: Start packages can be collected in advance on May 1st from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day. Races are on May 2nd: 10 km at 10:00, 5 km at 10:15, and a 1 km children's run at 10:20. An award ceremony will take place at 11:40. 40% of the entry fees are donated to charity. Participants receive medals, and winners receive cups, vouchers, and gifts. There will be sports demonstrations, physical challenges, and a raffle with prizes. The course runs through Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. Registration is online or on-site, and participants receive medals and the chance to win prizes. Places are limited.

name: Коджа Кая
location: село Билка, район връх Коджа Кая, България
description: Kozha Kaya is Bulgaria's first fully autonomous ultramarathon, held in the village of Bilka, in the Kozha Kaya peak area. The race offers various distances with significant positive elevation gains and no support stations, making it a true test of endurance and skills. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset, enjoying stunning views and natural beauty. This is an event for adventure and mountain running enthusiasts, leaving a lifelong memory.
course_highlights: 75 km with 4400 m positive elevation gain and full autonomy
42 km marathon with over 2700 m positive elevation gain without support stations
30 km Sky with 1950 m positive elevation gain and full autonomy
additional: All distances are with full autonomy, without support stations. There is an additional challenge - a speed ascent of Kozha Kaya 3.6 km with 500 m positive elevation gain. The event takes place in a natural environment rich in flora and fauna, offering breathtaking views and challenging terrains. The race is scheduled for May 1-2, 2026, with participants able to choose between different distances suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs. Registration is available on the official website.

name: МарицаРън 2026
location: Димитровград, Парк Марица, Димитровград, Хасково, България
description: MaritsaRun 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances - 1 km for children up to 14 years old, 5 km for a fun sports challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including alleys, the river, relaxation zone, and art installations. Participants will enjoy a good atmosphere with music, an audience, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition with a prize fund of over 1500 euros.
course_highlights: The course passes through the main entrance, alleys, the river, relaxation zone, and art installations of Maritsa Park
Distances: 1 km children's run, 5 km and 10 km for adults
Hydration stations and support along the route
additional: Registration is possible online or on-site on the day of the event if there are available starting numbers. Late registration is possible after 15.04.2026. Medals for all finishers and monetary and material prizes for the winners. The event features music, professional photographers, and a festive atmosphere. Registration is online or on-site, with late registration after 15.04. The event includes a children's run and routes in Maritsa Park, supporting a healthy lifestyle and community.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
price_range: 15 € до 30 € за участие, 20 € за тениска на събитието
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at the Olympic Square. The courses pass through mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with varying elevation gains, challenging participants with true mountain terrain. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners are awarded cash and material prizes.
course_highlights: Mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Distances with positive elevation gain from 420 m to 1640 m
Start and finish at the Olympic Square in Chepelare
additional: Start packages are distributed on May 2 from 15:00 to 20:00 at Borika Hotel and on May 3 from 8:00 at the Olympic Square. Participants under 16 years old can only participate in the 7.6 km distance. Every finisher receives a medal, and prizes for the top three places include cash and material awards. It is recommended to fill out participation declarations in advance. Payment at the moment is only via bank transfer. The distances include 7.6 km, 15 km, and 30 km with positive elevation gains of 420 m, 820 m, and 1640 m respectively; start and finish at the Olympic Square in Chepelare; the courses are in mountain and forest terrains.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship - uphill and downhill for men and women, as well as for boys and girls under 20, under 18, and under 16, is held in Chepelare. The competition offers a challenging mountain terrain that tests the endurance and skills of the participants. This is an important sports event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional organization and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with uphill and downhill sections
Categories for men, women, and boys and girls under 20, 18, and 16
Held in the picturesque area of Chepelare
additional: For all inquiries, participants should contact the organizer directly at the provided email. The event is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and is officially supported. It is included in the national mountain running calendar and offers participation opportunities across various age groups.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
description: Heidiushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants compete in climbing the iconic trail from the start to the large fountain near the Karanli Hotel, with various route options of different difficulty levels. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize fund, and results are officially recorded and published for each participant who completes the trail in under 1 hour. This is a unique challenge for mountain running and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Climbing the iconic Heidiushka Path in Sinite Kamani Nature Park
Route with various variations - the shortest is the steepest and most difficult
Finish at the large fountain near Karanli Hotel
additional: The race has no categories, age restrictions, or prize fund. Only the time from start to finish is measured. The record holder's name is inscribed on a special plaque at the beginning of the trail. Participants with times under 1 hour have their results published on the Foundation "Stari Bryast" website. The event includes trail running with different routes and no categories or prizes, emphasizing personal achievements and records.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
description: Yunashki Games 2026 are held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6th, in honor of Haji Dimitar's birthday and Gergyovden - the Day of Bravery. The event is dedicated to the traditions and spirit of the hajduks, including games and competitions that they used to measure their strength when choosing a voivode. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region's historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. It is organized by the Old Oak Foundation, which works to preserve the cultural heritage and nature of Sliven.
course_highlights: Held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park with alpine-type terrain
The course passes along ancient hajduk trails and near 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
A place with numerous rocky peaks, steep slopes, caves, and waterfalls
additional: The event is part of the traditional patriotic causes of the Old Oak Foundation, held in honor of historical figures and events related to the hajduks and Bulgarian history. Registration and briefing take place at the Information Center of Sinite Kamani Nature Park; competitions include stone throwing and knife throwing; participants in folk costumes are encouraged.

name: Международен турнир за юноши и девойки под 18 г. „Младост”
description: The Youth and Junior Athletics Tournament "Mladost" is held at the City Stadium in Ruse. This is a competition with a rich tradition, bringing together young athletes from different countries to compete in various athletics disciplines. The tournament aims to promote youth sports and provides an opportunity for talented competitors under 18 years old to showcase their skills. Organizers emphasize the importance of registered achievements for participation in some disciplines, such as the long jump for girls under 18.
course_highlights: Competitions at the City Stadium in Ruse
International participation of boys and girls under 18
21 athletics disciplines
additional: Participation in the long jump for girls under 18 requires registered achievements; athletes without such achievements will not be admitted. The competition includes 21 disciplines with over 300 participants. Results and start lists are publicly available. Participation is open to young athletes under 18, and the event is part of preparations for European championships and international competitions.

name: Трън Ултра Рън
description: Trun Ultra Run is an ultramarathon mountain running race held in the picturesque region of Kraiishte, centered in the village of Turokovtsi, Trun Municipality. The race offers four routes of varying lengths and elevation gains, passing through the Ruy, Ezimir and Reben mountains, with numerous panoramic views and diverse terrain from soft trails to rocky sections. Organized by the Trun Tourist Society with the support of Trun Municipality, the event is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and beautiful nature.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the peaks Maly Ruy, Orlovets, Rakitki Kamik, and the Erma River Gorge
Diverse terrain - soft trails, rocky sections, steep inclines, and panoramic views
additional: All routes are circular with start and finish in Turokovtsi village. Support stations with water and food are available along the routes, but cups are not provided. Each participant must have mandatory insurance. Medical personnel and an ambulance are available at the start/finish. Use of GPS tracks in .gpx format is recommended. The routes are circular, with support points and medical assistance; participants must carry mandatory equipment and use GPS tracks. The race is part of a series of routes and is certified by ITRA.

name: Alpinist TRI
description: Climbing Triathlon "New Life for Alpiniist Hut" is a unique race that replaces traditional swimming with a vertical challenge. It takes place in the area of Alpiniist Hut and Basarbovo village, Ruse, and includes three disciplines: MTB cycling, running, and final ascent via Via Ferrata. The race is both individual and relay, with all proceeds going towards the restoration of the hut. It is an opportunity to test your strength against nature and support a noble cause in one of the most beautiful regions of Polomieto.
course_highlights: MTB cycling 21 km with +350 m elevation gain
Running 10 km with +220 m elevation gain
Final ascent via the newest Via Ferrata in Northern Bulgaria
additional: The start is in front of Alpiniist Hut, Basarbovo. The relay team consists of two people, with the fee being for the entire team. Relay categories are male, female, and mixed. The event supports the restoration of Alpiniist Hut. Routes: MTB 21 km, running 10 km, Via Ferrata; categories: individual and relay; location: Alpiniist Hut, Basarbovo; date: May 9, 2026.

name: Amusnet Charity Run 2026
description: Amusnet Charity Run 2026 is a trail run with a cause, taking place near the village of Zheleznitsa, close to Sofia. The course is just over 5 km and features diverse terrain with a beautiful forest trail, a challenging ascent, and a final descent. The event is open to everyone - for running and walking, with the main goal of participating and supporting the National Paralympic Federation. For every kilometer covered, Amusnet donates 5 euros to support the cause, which helps Bulgarian athletes with disabilities.
course_highlights: 0-3 km: flat and beautiful forest trail
3-4 km: serious ascent of about 1 km
4-5+ km: descent and final sprint to the finish
additional: Professional timing with published results after the event. Parking near the start is limited; it is recommended to use the large parking lot at the end of the village, about 2 km walk to the start-finish area. Participation is free. The course is just over 5 km with diverse terrain; support for Paralympians; registration via the form; limited parking capacity; prizes for participants and staff.

name: Tran Ultra Run
description: Trun Ultra Run is a mountain race held in the picturesque region of Kraiishte, centered in the village of Turokovtsi, Trun Municipality. The race offers four routes of varying lengths and ascents, passing through the mountains Ruy, Ezimirska, and Greben, with numerous peaks and panoramic views. The courses are circular, with diverse terrain including soft trails, rocky sections, steep inclines, and forest areas. Organized by the Trun Tourist Society with the support of Trun Municipality, the event provides marking, refreshment points, and medical assistance for participants.
course_highlights: Four circular routes of 14 km, 23 km, 43 km, and 64 km with ascents from 700 to 3300 meters
Routes through the mountains Ruy, Ezimirska, and Greben with numerous peaks and panoramic views
Diverse terrain including soft trails, rocky sections, steep inclines, and forest areas
additional: All routes are circular with start and finish in the village of Turokovtsi. There are refreshment points along the courses with water and food, but cups are not provided. Participants are required to have mandatory insurance. Medical personnel and an ambulance are available at the start/finish. Use of GPS tracks in .gpx format is recommended. Multiple routes of different lengths through scenic Bulgaria, awaiting certification from ITRA.

location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria

description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new mountain running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the picturesque area "Kara Dere" near the village of Elenovo, with various routes suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity for sport and nature combined with local traditions. Organizers provide GPX files for the routes to assist participants in their preparation.
course_highlights: Routes with lengths of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km in mountain terrain
Area "Kara Dere" with scenic views and natural beauty
Held within a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the routes are available for download and preparation. The event takes place in an area with the "Kara Dere" dam. The organizer is the Tourist Information Center - Nova Zagora, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The routes are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural events in the "Kara Dere" area.

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging run along the rugged rocks of Bulgaria's northern coast, offering three distances - 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes through iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance and the beauty of the seaside landscape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. This is a unique experience for nature and running enthusiasts seeking adventure and inspiration.
course_highlights: 42 km rugged coastal beauty with endless horizon
17 km through breathtaking cliffs and sea breeze
7 km fast and impressive kilometers along the coast
additional: Start packages are available in the cities of Varna and Shabla with a signed participation declaration. When collecting a start package for another participant, a signed declaration from them is required. Participants under 18 years old need a parental consent declaration. The medal symbolizes the sunrise, waves, and the path, while the T-shirt is an artistic interpretation of the event. After the race, participants can celebrate with wine from the partner Villa Daros. The event includes races of various distances, supported by local authorities, and offers a unique opportunity to run amidst the natural beauty of the Black Sea coast.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants run until they are caught by the virtual "Catcher Car," which starts 30 minutes after the beginning and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of registration fees and donations going to this cause. Participants can gather at the popular spot "Sun" in Borisova Gradina and join via the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.
course_highlights: Start at the popular "Sun" area in Borisova Gradina
1.8 km of asphalt paths in the park
1.2 km of dirt and gravel trail, followed by 1.8 km of wide asphalt road
additional: The race is accessible for wheelchair participants. The virtual "Catcher Car" begins chasing participants 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h, which gradually increases. 100% of registration fees and donations are directed to spinal cord research. Participants must use the Wings for Life World Run mobile app to participate and track their progress. Participants can join via the app or on-site, as the event is focused on charity and supporting scientific research. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels.

name: XL kmrun - Плана
description: The XL Race is a trail race, part of the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the area of the village of Plana, near Sofia, in the Plana mountain. Participants can choose between three distances - 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km, which pass through open terrains with diverse conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km
The route is open, without shade, with diverse terrains
Held in the Plana mountain near Sofia
additional: Choice of three distances with different lengths. The route is mostly open, which can be challenging in strong sunlight. Organized by 5kmrun. The race is held annually in May in the area of the village of Plana. Trail races, distances 5.5 km, 11 km, 16.5 km, taking place in the area of the village of Plana.

name: Луковит рън
description: The Lukovit Run road race is an annual competition with a length of 8.8 kilometers, starting from the center of Lukovit and reaching the Prohodna Cave. The event attracts runners of various ages and levels, with notable winners such as Ismail Senandzhi and Marinela Nineva. It is part of the sports calendar of Lukovit Municipality and offers a mass start of 800 meters for younger participants. The course is scenic and challenging, combining urban and natural environments.
course_highlights: The course is 8.8 km long from the center of Lukovit to Prohodna Cave
Includes a mass start of 800 meters for younger participants
Held in a scenic natural and urban environment
additional: The oldest participant was 70 years old. The winner, Ismail Senandzhi, has five victories on the course. The event also features a mass start of 800 meters. It takes place on May 10, 2026, with cash prizes for the winners and medals for participants. The event is part of the Run Bulgaria series and is popular among running enthusiasts in the region.

description: The Rose Valley Marathon in Kazanlak is a sporting event designed for all running enthusiasts, with the main goal of increasing physical activity and showcasing the beauty of the Rose Valley in Bulgaria. The competition includes three distances - a classic marathon of 42 km, a half marathon of 21 km, and a 10 km race. The start and finish are at Rozarium Park in front of the Rose Museum in Kazanlak, and the course passes through the city area, bike lanes, and secondary road network, with an elevation of about 100 meters. The event takes place on May 10, 2026, starting at 09:00 AM, and offers refreshment points every 5 km, as well as awards in various categories.
course_highlights: The first 10 km are in the city area
The course passes through bike lanes and secondary road network
Elevation around 100 meters
additional: Starting packages are available on May 8 and 9, 2026, at the office of TD "Orlov Gnezdо" and on May 10, 2026, at the start/finish park Rozarium. There are refreshment points along the course with water, drinks, and fruits approximately every 5 km. In the start/finish zone, there are designated areas for personal belongings with labels bearing the start number. The awards ceremony begins at 13:00 and includes categories for overall ranking and youth. Registration is from 08:00 to 09:00 on-site, with the start at 09:00. The event features different distances and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Мемориал „Веселин Даскалов”
description: The Veselin Daskalov Memorial is a traditional athletics competition held in Lukovit, Bulgaria. The 20th anniversary edition took place at the city stadium with over 200 athletes from across the country competing in various distances from 100 m to 1500 m. The event attracts both children and national competitors, providing opportunities for young talents and established athletes to showcase their skills. Organizers ensure an official award ceremony with participation from local representatives and sports figures.
course_highlights: City stadium in Lukovit with well-maintained track
Disciplines from 100 m to 1500 m for different age groups
Participation of over 200 athletes from 35 clubs nationwide
additional: The competition includes various age groups with distances from 100 m to 1500 m. Award ceremonies feature representatives of the Lukovit municipality and sports figures. The event is part of the regional sports calendar and attracts national athletes and young talents. It is held at the city stadium in Lukovit, covering distances from 100 m to 1500 m, including children and adults, with participants from across the country.

description: IHB Business Run Varna is the largest team-building race in Bulgaria, held at the BulYard shipyard and Bulport Logistics in Varna. It is a relay race for teams of 4 people, with each participant running 4 km before passing the baton to the next. The event combines sports spirit and corporate teamwork, attracting many companies and their employees in a dynamic and friendly format. In addition to the main race, there is a Kids Run for children aged 4 to 12 with the support of certified coaches.
course_highlights: Relay race with teams of 4 people, each running 4 km
The route is in the industrial zone of BulYard shipbuilding industry and Bulport Logistics
Each lap is 2 km, each participant completes 2 laps
additional: Each participant receives a start number and safe pins for attachment. The baton is equipped with a chip for electronic timing. The start is at 9:00 AM, with the first runner arriving at the start line at 8:50 AM with the baton. Parking and a wardrobe are provided near the start area. Laser engraving of medals is available for an additional fee. Branded tents for teams are available for an extra charge. Registration deadlines are at the beginning of 2026. The event includes certificates and gifts, as well as opportunities for corporate participation and team building.

name: ApriltsiRun
organizer: Община Априлци, Сдружение „Троян в бъдещето“, НД „Традиция“ – 34-ти Пехотен Троянски полк
description: ApriltsiRun is a mountain running event inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race takes place along historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev, which the rebels traversed 150 years ago. The courses offer various levels of difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain running enthusiasts. The event combines sport, nature, and history, commemorating the anniversary of the uprising with panoramic routes and a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Courses with different difficulty levels: 3 km with 75 m elevation gain, 8 km with 245 m elevation gain, 26 km with 1514 m elevation gain
Routes pass through historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev
Panoramic views and natural beauty in the Apriltsi area
additional: Organizers are the Apriltsi Municipality, the Association "Troyan in the Future," and the National Defense "Tradition" - 34th Troyan Infantry Regiment. The race has a charitable focus, with proceeds directed towards causes related to cancer fight and the promotion of historical and natural heritage. The event aims to combine sport, history, and cultural heritage, offering different difficulty levels and suitable for both professionals and amateurs. It is held in honor of the 150th anniversary of the April Uprising.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the seaside city, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course passes through the beautiful Varna coastline, offering fresh air and picturesque views of the sea. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon is a test of endurance and strength of spirit, inspiring participants to achieve new personal goals.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Varna coastline with sea views
The race takes place in the seaside city of Bulgaria
Atmosphere with support from local fans and international participants
additional: Late registration on-site is possible subject to availability at the information center operating from May 12 to 16, 2026. Bib numbers are only available on race day from 07:00 to 09:00 at Independence Square near the Varna Opera. The event also includes a 2 km city cross with Decathlon. Distances: 42 km and 21 km; registration online and on-site; event with a large number of participants and sponsors; held in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: Plovdiv Friendship Marathon is a traditional event held on May 17, 2026, in the center of Plovdiv. The competition includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km, relay race, and Vidas Run Kids children's marathon. The routes are certified and pass through scenic parts of the city and Kyulak Park, combining sport with a charity cause to support medical students. Organizers provide refreshment stations, medical services, and a rich program for race day.
course_highlights: The marathon consists of 4 laps with two turnaround points
Refreshment stations every 5-6 km and water points every 3 km along the route
The route passes through Kyulak Park and scenic parts of Plovdiv
additional: Start packages are distributed at the Children's Work Center on May 16 from 10:30 to 15:00 and on May 17 from 7:15 to 8:00. Personal energy products can be handed over on May 17 from 8:00 to 8:30. There is a medical station and ambulance on the route. The awards ceremony is at 13:30, and a special run with BALIЗ starts at 9:35. Registration is free for participants over 60 years old and people with disabilities upon request with documents. Payment can be made via PayPal or bank transfer. Route, registration, charity cause, children's marathon.

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spici i Bodli 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon race held at the foot of the Balkan Mountains near Kazanlak. The event offers various routes with different difficulty levels, suitable for both beginners and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sports competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival with live music, summer cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event combines sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: Hobby route is 37 km with a positive elevation of 1274 m, suitable for cyclists of all levels
Difficult route is 47 km with an elevation of 1781 m, including serious climbs and technical descents for advanced riders
The duathlon includes 37 km of cycling and 22 km of running, with the course overlapping the Hobby route
additional: Registration includes insurance for medical and rescue expenses, support for a charitable cause, refreshment points with food and drinks, medical team, as well as festival activities at the start-finish line such as live music, horseback riding, archery, and aerial yoga. A children's race for kids up to 12 years old takes place on 16.05.2026 at 17:00 near the start-finish line. It includes a children's race, tent camp, insurance, support points, and charity activities.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalanga Marathon is a jubilee event that in 2026 marks its 10th anniversary. It takes place in Sinemorets village and offers mountain running distances of 42, 21, 13 km and 3 km for children, as well as mountain biking on 42 and 21 km. The routes pass through the scenic trails of Strandzha Nature Park, combining sport, nature, and community. The event includes start packages, awards, and a party, creating a festive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in Strandzha Nature Park
Circular tracks with start and finish at Veleka Beach
Stations with fresh fruits, vegetables, and isotonic drinks
additional: The running starts are on May 23 with checkpoint times for each distance. On May 24, mountain biking takes place with two distances. The starts and finishes are at Veleka Beach (North). Food and drink stations are provided along the routes. MTB bikes without electric assistance are allowed for cycling. After the race, there is a party at the 'Kora' bar. Early reservation for accommodation is recommended, for example at Casa Domingo in Sinemorets. Running and cycling routes, on-site registration, anniversary edition, natural routes in Strandzha.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON TRACIA UTRA is mountain running that recreates the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances suitable for beginners, advanced, and experts, including ultra-long routes with stunning views and challenges. This event combines the sporting spirit, history, and love for nature, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants. Join us and discover the magic of Trakia in the heart of the Rhodopes.
course_highlights: 95K ultra-long distance with challenging and scenic mountain routes
Night Run Night Trail 6K under the stars
Dynamic and picturesque routes for 12K and 20K distances
additional: The race includes distances from 6K to 95K, suitable for runners of different levels. There is a special run for children - DECATHLON Kids Run. A monthly raffle with prizes for registered participants is held. Multiple distances, mountain running, registration for the raffle, children's race.

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The "Yordanka Arizanova" Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of the legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who created hundreds of excellent athletes. The tournament takes place at Plovdiv Stadium and includes disciplines such as 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, where the coach achieved her greatest successes. The event attracts both young and established athletes who honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.
course_highlights: Competitions at Plovdiv Stadium
Disciplines: 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 400 m hurdles
Traditional participation of top sprinters and runners
additional: The competition includes heats for children in the morning and for senior athletes in the afternoon. Winners are awarded by Yordanka Arizanova's daughter - Angelina Petrova-Hristova. The tournament is held annually at Plovdiv Stadium and features disciplines such as 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1500 m, and 400 m hurdles, with awards for the winners.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra is mountain running that recreates the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances suitable for beginners, advanced, and experts, including ultra-long routes with stunning views and challenges. The unique night run Night Trail 6K and the children's race DECATHLON Kids Run complete the program, turning the event into a true celebration of sports spirit and love for nature. Organized by DECATHLON Plovdiv, the race promises impeccable organization and unforgettable experiences in the beautiful area of Shiroka Laka, Smolyan.
course_highlights: 95K ultra-long distance with challenging and scenic routes
Night run Night Trail 6K under the stars
Dynamic and scenic routes for 12K and 20K distances
additional: Every month DECATHLON distributes prizes through a raffle for registered participants. The event includes distances for all ages from 6K night run to 95K ultra. Organizer is DECATHLON Plovdiv with excellent organization rating. Routes for different distances, mountain running, registration for raffle, children's race

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in Zhelava village, Sofia. This is a challenging run that attracts mountain running enthusiasts and nature lovers. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful landscapes and diverse terrain around Sofia. The organizers provide professional organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with diverse ascents and descents
Beautiful natural views around Zhelava village
Part of the established RunBG Trail Series
additional: The event is part of a series of trail races held in Bulgaria, aimed at both amateurs and professionals wishing to test their strength in mountain conditions.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking race in the cross-country marathon (XCM) discipline, held in the village of Zhelava. The race offers three main routes with varying lengths and positive elevation gain, suitable for different categories of competitors, including hobby and electric bikes. The routes pass through scenic and challenging terrains, including the famous Zhelava Trail, which is popular among cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for moderately and well-prepared cyclists.
course_highlights: Murgash Epic - 62 km with 2505 m positive elevation gain
Murgash Classic - 40 km with 1348 m positive elevation gain
Zhelava Trail - iconic section with 9.9 km ascent
additional: The race includes categories for juniors and girls in various age groups, as well as a category for electric bicycles with assistance up to 25 km/h. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes. Multiple routes with different lengths and elevation gains, suitable for various levels of preparation, including E-bike category.

name: Rhodo Rock
description: Rhodo Rock is a remarkable ultramarathon held in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains, near the town of Momchilgrad. This unique sporting event attracts participants from around the world who love the challenges of mountain routes and the beauty of nature. The race offers a variety of routes, including peaks, valleys, rivers, and forest trails, suitable for both professional athletes and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Participants can expect an exciting experience and an atmosphere that combines sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with peaks and valleys
Crossing rivers and forest trails
Picturesque nature of the Rhodope Mountains
additional: All participants receive a finisher medal within the control time for distances of 60km, 42km, 21km, and 9km. Included are a T-shirt with an original design, gifts in the starter pack, time measurement, medical examination upon receiving the start number, medical teams during the event, photo coverage, and all necessary permits. Multiple routes, mountain terrains, natural beauty, competition for amateurs and professionals.

name: Salomon Vitosha Trail
description: Salomon Vitosha Trail 2026 is a mountain race that offers a unique experience amidst the wild nature of Vitosha. The race includes three distances with varying difficulty and elevation, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Aleko Hut, and the routes pass through diverse terrain, including a climb to Cherni Vrah - the highest point of Vitosha. The organizers aim to develop the trail running culture in Bulgaria and promote an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Routes of 40 km, 27 km, and 12 km with elevation gains of 2000, 1300, and 600 meters
Passing through Cherni Vrah - the highest point of Vitosha (2290 m)
Diverse terrain: forest trails, wet peat, rocky paths, streams, and moraines
additional: Start number includes a timing chip. Awards are given at Aleko Hut after the finish of the third runner in each distance and group. Each participant receives a medal and a one-week fitness training card at Next Level. Participants with paid registration benefit from a 30% discount on Salomon products and 10% on Suunto at Sport Box store. Use of GPS devices for navigation on the routes is recommended. The routes vary from 12 km to 40 km and include a climb to Cherni Vrah; conditions include mud, stones, forests, and open fields; registration is available online or on-site.

name: Национален шампионат под 18 г.
description: The National Under 18 Championship in Stara Zagora is a prestigious athletics competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The event gathers young athletes under 18 who compete in various track disciplines. It is part of the national calendar and provides an opportunity for young talents in athletics to showcase and develop their skills.
course_highlights: Track competitions in Stara Zagora
Participation of young athletes under 18
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: The competition will bring together young athletes from across the country and will be an important part of the national youth sports program.

description: Business Run Sofia is the largest team building event in Bulgaria, bringing together employees from different companies for a corporate relay race. The competition includes teams of 4 participants, each running 4 laps of 1.2 km, totaling 4.8 km. In addition to the relay, there are also Power Walk, CEO Dash, and Kids Run, with each participant receiving insurance, a medal, and gifts. The event is a great opportunity for team bonding and active recreation among colleagues.
course_highlights: Relay: 4 participants, 4 laps of 1.2 km each (total 4.8 km)
Power Walk: team of 4, 1 lap of 4 km together
CEO Dash: 1 lap of 1.2 km
additional: Each participant receives accident insurance from MetLife for the day of the event. Each team receives a set of beach towels, a medal that can be assembled, a plaque with the company's ranking, and gifts from partners. There is an option for laser engraving on the medals (40 euros excluding VAT per team) and a branded tent (1000 euros excluding VAT). It is recommended to arrive at least an hour early, with the possibility to use a wardrobe. Parking at Vasil Levski Stadium is closed; metro is recommended. Team building event with various activities, company participation, urban terrain, different prices depending on registration date.

name: Лудогорски маратон
description: Ludogorski Marathon is an annual event held in the natural area Pchelin near Razgrad. The course mainly passes through forest roads and trails, with varied terrain and beautiful nature, part of the protected zone "Ostviche". The competition includes various disciplines such as running, cycling, duathlon, and triathlon with swimming in Pchelin Lake. The organizer is the "Green Step" club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is almost entirely in the forest - on forest roads and trails without pavement, with a small part of macadam and asphalt
Swimming in Pchelin Lake - 2 with a beach as the start/finish for the triathlon
The total elevation gain for the 25 km run is 710 meters with varied terrain and three support points
additional: Starts are at the meadow with the sports grounds in the Pchelin area. Control and support points are approximately every 5 km with water, fruits, and medical supplies. Numbers are registered at the points. Littering is only allowed at the points or within a 50-meter radius of them. A guarded transit zone for triathlon and duathlon is included. Participants can choose a number from 1 to 999 during registration. There is an option to order a T-shirt with an original design for an additional fee. The event offers a tent camp, support points every 5 km, prizes, and accommodation options in huts and tents. It takes place on the last Sunday of July and is aimed at amateurs and professionals who want to enjoy nature and sports.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championship for athletes under 14 in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together over 300 young athletes from across the country. It is held at the "Hristo Botev" stadium and offers an opportunity for the youngest talents to showcase their skills in classic athletics disciplines. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation's sports calendar and is held concurrently with the international tournament "Nikola Vulchanov". This is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Competitions at the "Hristo Botev" stadium in Gabrovo
Classic athletics disciplines for under 14 years old
Two-day format with over 300 participants from across the country
additional: Held at the "Hristo Botev" stadium in Gabrovo, the event is part of the national sports calendar for 2026.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Beyond the Bridge is a unique bike and run event in Lovech, combining a sports challenge with historical and natural attractions. Participants pass through four iconic bridges and beautiful routes, including the Devetashko Plateau, Kăkrinsko Han, Hisarya Fortress, and the parks Bash Bunar and Stratesh. The event is suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners, with 20% of the fees allocated to charity. It is an opportunity to enjoy nature, history, and experience an unforgettable adventure.
course_highlights: Passing through four iconic bridges in Lovech
Muddy and rocky trails on the Devetashko Plateau
Historical landmarks such as Kăkrinsko Han and Hisarya Fortress
additional: Registration is conducted online or on-site on designated days. In the last two weeks before the event, registration is possible with restrictions - without a personalized start number and with a merchandise item by size on-site. The fee is determined by the moment of payment. No medical examination is required for the 5 km run. Support stations with food and drinks are included, as well as medals for finishers, product prizes, and discount vouchers from partners. The duathlon includes 40 km cycling + 12 km running, charity campaign, historical routes, and natural scenery.

name: Тепе Джамборе 2026 Tepe Jambore
location: Летен театър, Пловдив, Пловдивска област, България
description: Teppe Jamboree is a sports and cultural marathon in Plovdiv that combines running, movement, and culture through the city center and its hills. The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural activities such as jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through iconic city landmarks, hills, alleys, and green areas, suitable for all ages and fitness levels. This is not a standard race but an experience that unites the community and supports causes for people with unequal opportunities.
course_highlights: Champion Jamboree - 13 km with 450 meters of positive elevation, passing through all the hills of Plovdiv
Relaxed Jamboree - 7 km with 250 meters of positive elevation
Children's Jamboree - 1 km in Bunardzhik Park with a safe route and controlled environment
additional: The event includes cultural stops with theater, music, dance, beer and wine with snacks, artists, and surprises. The start-finish zone features a party with music and entertainment. There is an opportunity for volunteering in the Jamboree Squad with support from participants and organizers. Corporate teams participate in a competition with team spirit and donations for the voluntary formation “Plovdiv112”. The routes include 13 km, 7 km, and 1 km distances; the event is part of the Plovdiv 2026 cultural calendar and offers entertainment for the whole family.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"

description: The Nikola Valchanov Athletics Tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at the Aprilov Stadium. It includes 17 disciplines, among them sprint races and shot put, for various age groups from under 14 to men and women. The organizers are the Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATHLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and features an official opening at 11:00 AM.
course_highlights: Competitions at Aprilov Stadium in Gabrovo
17 disciplines, including sprint races and shot put
Participation of various age groups - from under 14 to men and women
additional: The official opening of the tournament is at 11:00 AM at Aprilov Stadium. Organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATHLET athletics club. The event includes disciplines for different age groups. The tournament features 17 disciplines, with participants from 23 clubs, and a record number of over 170 athletes.

name: ДИВОТО ЗОВЕ МАДЖАРОВО 2026
description: The Wild Call Madjarovo is an annual race that combines cycling and trail running in the picturesque Eastern Rhodopes. The event takes place in the town of Madjarovo, located in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique nature and historical landmarks. The routes offer a variety of distances and challenges suitable for both amateurs and elite competitors. Organized by the Dimităr Madjarov Cycling Club, the race aims to showcase the beauty of the region and bring together sports enthusiasts in a spirit of adventure and environmental consciousness.
course_highlights: Trail running with elevation gain up to 900 m and panoramic views of Botev Peak
Routes passing through dense forests, ancient paths, and near a waterfall
Unique nature in the volcano crater and close to the Arda River with impressive meanders
additional: Start and finish at the square in front of the Municipality in Madjarovo. Services included are chip timing, mountain rescue service, emergency medical assistance, a tasty lunch in the festival area, and camping options in the Arda River canyon or in a tent camp in the town park. Multiple distances for MTB, duathlon, and trail run, with races on June 13 and 14, 2026, including children's races and eco-activities.

name: Triglav Skyrun
location: село Тъжа, Национален парк Централен Балкан, България
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain race held in Central Balkan National Park, Bulgaria. The course passes through three iconic huts - Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka, and includes a climb to the third highest peak in Stara Planina - Golyam Kademlia (2275.4 m). The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, starting from the picturesque village of Taja, which is the starting point for all three routes. This event is for mountain running and nature enthusiasts, combining challenge and the beauty of the wild mountain.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Sokolna reserve with pristine nature
Climb to Golyam Kademlia peak - 2275.4 m
Passing through three iconic huts - Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka
additional: The start is in the village of Taja. There are three distances with different start times: 7:30 for 34K, 8:30 for 20K, and 9:00 for 12K. Race packets are distributed both the evening before the race and on the race day from 6:00 until 15 minutes before the start. Awards begin at 14:00. All winners receive a race logo t-shirt. There is an option to order a designer t-shirt during registration. Participants under 18 are only allowed to compete in the 12K and 20K with a parental declaration. Refunds are possible until 30.04.2026 with a 20% fee; after that, no refunds are issued. Organizers are seeking volunteers to assist with organization. Courses: 12K, 20K, 34K; registration is open until the limit of 300 spots is reached; option to order designer t-shirts during registration; the event includes social activities and camping opportunities.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Barefoot running with a smile is a unique event held in the picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers an opportunity for barefoot running, combining sport and pleasure amidst nature. The event is suitable for everyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running barefoot in a beautiful and inspiring setting.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on natural terrains
Picturesque views of the Belogradchik Rocks
Unique atmosphere of freedom and smiles

name: У Царството на ТрибАлете
description: The mountain race "U Tsarstvoto na TribaLete" is a unique event in the heart of Vrachanski Balkan, offering a challenging 12.7 km distance with nearly 1000 meters of elevation gain. The course passes through beautiful natural landmarks such as Borov Kamak waterfall and the peaks Dudil and Buk, combining steep ascents with technical descents. The race is intended for enthusiasts of natural beauty and mountain running, with prizes distributed along the course and including special surprises from the heart. Organized by BG Events & Guiding, it is part of a series of events promoting Northwestern Bulgaria as a destination for sports and tourism.
course_highlights: 12.7 km with nearly 1000 m elevation gain
Passing under Borov Kamak waterfall over 70 m high
Technical and steep descent from Buzh peak with views of Vrachanski Balkan and Iskar Gorge
additional: The start is at the entrance of Borov Kamak eco trail, and the finish is in the pine forest. The first 5 km are the most difficult with the greatest ascent. Prizes are distributed along the course. Registration by phone at 0878 259 772. The route includes waterfalls, ascents, descents, technical parts, and natural beauty.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The XVI Bulgarian National Folklore Championship "Euro Folk 2026" is held in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), aiming to preserve, develop, and promote Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dances, choirs, songs, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and processed folklore performances. The event is part of the long-standing tradition of EAFF and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital Veliko Tarnovo.
course_highlights: Folklore competitions and performances of traditional Bulgarian groups
International participation and exchange of cultural traditions
Opportunity to participate and observe cultural events and workshops
additional: Participants apply via an online form on the official website. The event includes categories for adults and children, with various folklore genres and a competitive nature. The organizer is the European Association of Folklore Festivals, accredited by UNESCO for consulting services in the field of intangible cultural heritage. The festival features participants from all over Bulgaria, a rich program of cultural events, awards, and opportunities for exchanging traditions.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling race held in Bedekka Park and the southern slopes of the Middle Mountain near Stara Zagora. The event offers various distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the 'In Green' festival. The routes pass by the three ritual Thracian mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different levels of preparation. Participants receive a starter pack with a race number and support along the course.
course_highlights: Trail half marathon 21 km through the three ritual Thracian mounds 'Green Pyramids'
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33, and 65 km near the city
Courses of varying difficulty suitable for all levels of preparation
additional: Participation for children up to 12 years old is free. The event is part of the 'In Green' festival from June 19 to 21 in Bedekka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation Cup with different categories. The festival includes sports competitions, workshops, music, cinema, and food; a new location - Cypress Grove has been added.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, listed as a UNESCO site. The race offers several distances suitable for trail running and mountain running enthusiasts, with stunning views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience in the natural beauty of Bulgaria, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in Pirin National Park, included in UNESCO
Impressive views and trail running route
Variety of distances: 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km
additional: For the 38 km and 160 km distances, 2 and 4 ITRA points respectively from a previous race are required for registration. Registration and gear check are mandatory and are conducted at specific times before the start. Transportation to the start area is organized for the 25 km distance. Awards are presented at the Central Square in Bansko. Multi-distance race, including ultramarathon and scalar routes, with exceptional natural scenery.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race from the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun, held in Vranata Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop approximately 5 km long with minimal elevation change. Participants can choose between three distances - short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km), making it suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: The course is a loop approximately 5 km long
Held in Vranata Park, in the outskirts of Sofia
Minimal elevation change on the course
additional: The race offers a choice of three distances - 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The course is a loop of about 5 km, repeated according to the chosen distance. The elevation change is minimal, making it suitable for runners with different levels of preparation. The event is part of the XLkmrun calendar and includes various distances, taking place in Vranata Park, Sofia.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
location: Паметник 'Създатели на българската държава', Шумен, Шумен, Bulgaria
description: Shumen Plateau 2026 is a race held on June 21, 2026, in Shumen Plateau Nature Park, with start and finish points near the "Creators of the Bulgarian State" monument in the city of Shumen. Organized by Veloklub Ilchov Bair, the event includes disciplines such as cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on various routes, with rules for safety and environmental protection to be followed. The race is suitable for mountain biking and trail running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes in Shumen Plateau Nature Park with diverse terrain
Start and finish near the "Creators of the Bulgarian State" monument
Includes disciplines cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running
additional: Registration and distribution of race numbers take place on 21.06.2026 from 06:00 to 08:00 and from 16:00 to 20:00 at the information center near the "Creators of the Bulgarian State" monument. Wearing a helmet and gloves is mandatory for cyclists. For eMTB participants, the bicycle must meet EU requirements with a speed limit of up to 25 km/h and power up to 250 W. The use of chips that remove electric bicycle restrictions is prohibited. Participants under 18 years old must provide a written declaration from a parent. Disciplines include eMTB, cycling, running, and duathlon; registration and technical instructions will be provided on-site.

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The National Under 20 Championship, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that gathers the best young athletes in Bulgaria. It is held at a stadium in Sofia and provides an opportunity for development and exposure for youth in athletics. The event is part of the BFLA sports calendar for 2026 and is held under the auspices of the leading organization in Bulgarian athletics with a long-standing tradition and international recognition.
course_highlights: Competition at a stadium in Sofia
Participation of the best young athletes under 20
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation with a long-standing tradition
additional: The event is part of the national youth sports development program and will gather young athletes from across the country.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The Cross-Triathlon "In the footsteps of the Thracians" is the first edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings near Koprinka Dam, Kazanlak. Participants will go through challenging routes for swimming, cycling, and running amidst beautiful nature and diverse terrain. The event is suitable for both amateurs who want to test their strength and willpower, and for those seeking fun in nature. Organized by the sports club "Trayana-Triathlon" Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and atmosphere.
course_highlights: Swimming 2 km in the sandy shores of Koprinka Dam
Cycling 60 km in the forests of the Middle Mountain with rugged terrain
Running 15 km in the forest and along the shores of the dam with panoramic views
additional: Control times: swimming - 1:40 hours; cycling - 5:30 hours; running - 2:30 hours. The time saved by a participant in one stage is added to the next. Participation is only for persons over 18 years old. The day before the race, there is a children's competition for different age groups. Routes for swimming 2 km, cycling 60 km, running 14 km; registration with different prices; medals, refreshment points, professional timing, medical services, bike service, awards, and photos included.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultra marathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with diverse terrain. Organizers emphasize environmental protection and conduct the race without waste. Participants receive start packages and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: Circumference of Vitosha in 9 stages through villages and natural landmarks
Mountain ultra marathon with diverse terrain and altitude
Start and finish at Boyana Residence, Sofia
additional: Start numbers are distributed at ALPI store in Sofia and at the start line up to 60 minutes before the race. The race is conducted with an emphasis on environmental protection - participants are encouraged to bring their own bottles and not to litter. There is a special soft bottle SOFT FLASK 150ml for gels. The awards ceremony takes place on the race day after the finish. The race includes disciplines of running, cycling, and duathlon. The route includes hard-to-reach parts of the mountain with a total elevation gain of over 2000 meters; the race takes place in Sofia and is part of the mountain ultra marathon and cycling.

name: Troyan Run
location: Troyan, Troyan Municipality, Lovech Province, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 70 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 5 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is mountain running event held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the cause of Vasil Levski. The competition offers various routes with different levels of difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain running enthusiasts. The organizers are the association "Troyan in the Future," which works to promote the historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sports. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: Routes of different lengths: 3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 28 km, 42 km, and 70 km with varying elevation
Mountain terrain in the Troyan Balkan with natural and historical landmarks
Opportunity to participate for both professionals and amateurs
additional: Start packages are received on-site with priority given to longer distances. It is mandatory to wear a race number, carry a water bottle or hydration system (minimum 500 ml), and have a mobile phone with the organizers' contact number. The program includes a technical conference and an award ceremony. Multiple distances, historical theme, mountain running, charitable initiatives, routes with panoramic views, events for an active lifestyle.

name: Вършец ултра
description: Vârșeț Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for both experienced ultramarathon runners and beginners, including children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural environment of Vârșeț, with the start located in front of the Medicus Hotel. Participants can choose between an ultra distance of 48 km and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. This race combines sport, nature, and the opportunity for active relaxation in the Vârșeț national resort.
course_highlights: Mountain running with diverse distances
Start in front of Medicus Hotel in Vârșeț
Routes through picturesque natural environment
additional: Registration package available at Vârșeț municipality. Distances: ultra 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Dates: July 12-13, 2026. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Start from Medicus Hotel. Online registration.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Piasatsi is a unique running event held on July 4, 2026, on Bulgaria's longest beach strip between Kamchia Holiday Resort and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely sandy and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River with safety measures and auxiliary equipment provided. The race offers two main distances - 10 km and 21.1 km, as well as a children's run of 2.2 km. The organizer is the 'Green Step' club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is entirely sandy and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River
Distances are 10 km and 21.1 km with refreshment points approximately every 5 km
Opportunity to run barefoot and safety measures are provided for river crossing
additional: The start is in the evening, with race numbers distributed from 15:00 and luggage storage available. Cut-off time is 4 hours for 21.1 km and 3:30 hours for 10 km. Children can participate free of charge in the 2.2 km children's run. Participants are required to carry a water container for refreshment points. Timing is with RFID chips. In adverse conditions, crossing the river may be done by boats provided by the organizers. Distances include 10 km and 21.1 km, with refreshment points every approximately 5 km, online registration options, fees via EasyPay or ePay, and options for accompaniment and children under 7 years with a guardian.

name: Вършец рън
description: Vâršeț Run and Vâršeț Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, including children. The event takes place in the picturesque resort of Vâršeț, with the start line in front of the Medicus Hotel. The routes include an ultra distance of 48 km, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, providing opportunities for participation at different levels. Registration is done through the platform runbulgaria.org, and start packages are received in the municipality of Vâršeț.
course_highlights: Mountain running with an ultra distance of 48 km
Short mountain routes of 11.6 km and 5.9 km
Children's and beginner's distance of 1 km
additional: The start is in front of the Medicus Hotel. The start package is received in the municipality of Vâršeț. Registration is via the platform runbulgaria.org. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners; start in front of the Medicus Hotel; registration at www.runbulgaria.org.
