description: TRI Legend Batak 2026 is a triathlon event taking place on July 11, 2026, at Batak Reservoir. The competition offers three distances: Legend, Turbo, and Legend Relay, suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners. The course is marked and provides support stations, and the atmosphere is filled with friendliness and challenge. This is a place where the race happens with you, not just for you.
course_highlights: Legend: 1.9 km swimming, 90 km cycling, 21 km running
Turbo: 0.9 km swimming, 52 km cycling, 10 km running
Legend Relay: same distance as Legend, but in teams of two or three
additional: Marked course, support stations, limited spots for each distance (Legend - 120, Turbo - 60, Legend Relay - 20 teams). The event promotes community and friendship among participants. Distances: Legend (1.9 km swimming, 90 km cycling, 21 km running), Turbo (0.9 km swimming, 52 km cycling, 10 km running), Relay (same as Legend, in teams). Registration with different prices and locations. The event is part of the legendary experience in the Rhodopes and is suitable for both advanced and beginner athletes.

name: XL kmrun - Сеславци
description: XLkmrun is an amateur competitive athletics race over middle and long distances, offering a challenge for runners of various levels of preparation. The event takes place in Sofia and is part of the 5KM RUN initiative, which promotes a healthy lifestyle through free but organized running. It is an opportunity for everyone interested to participate in a sports atmosphere that supports diversity and community.
course_highlights: Middle and long distances
Organized but amateur competition
Held in Sofia
additional: The event is part of an initiative to promote running and a healthy lifestyle in Bulgaria.

name: Трявна ултра
description: Tryavna Ultra is an ultramarathon race offering challenging distances in the beautiful nature of the Balkan around the town of Tryavna. The race includes runs of 100 km, 42 km, and 21 km, as well as cycling routes and duathlon. The courses feature diverse terrain and include numerous support points, ensuring comfort and safety for participants. The organizer is the iRun association, which has extensive experience in organizing sports events and building a sports community.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon distances from 21 km to 100 km
Diverse mountain terrain with elevation profiles up to over 1500 m
Multiple support points along the courses
additional: The race includes running, cycling, and duathlon with combined distances. The organizer iRun is an association with over 50 sports events held. The website provides information on accommodation, the history of the race, and results from previous years. Multiple distances for running, cycling, and duathlon; event with technical conferences and starter packs; held in the town of Tryavna, Bulgaria.

name: Балкан ултра
description: The Balkan Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in the area of Pleven Hut, Apriltsi. The routes include technical sections with significant elevation gain and require good physical fitness and mountaineering skills. Participants can choose between two main distances - Sky and Ultra, each with a unique route through beautiful and difficult mountain terrains. The race offers stunning views and diverse trails, including crossing peaks such as Botev and the Milk Chute.
course_highlights: Technical sections with significant elevation gain and ascent to Botev Peak
Riding along the mountain ridge with varied terrain and steep descents
Long ridge running and passing through multiple huts and control points
additional: Participants in the Ultra distance must have valid mountain insurance and have completed two races with at least 4000 meters of elevation gain in the last 3 years. For the Sky distance, participation is free. A GPS device is mandatory for navigation along the provided GPS track. There are control points with cut-off times, for example at Petolachka - 10 hours. The routes include technical sections; options for accommodation include Pleven Hut, camping, or Apriltsi; the race length is approximately 78 km, with a record under 13 hours.

name: Национален шампионат под 23г.
description: The National Championship for boys and girls under 18 is one of the most popular competitions in the sports calendar of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The competition includes various disciplines, with discus and hammer events held at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad. Traditionally, the championship gathers young athletes from across the country, providing them with the opportunity to compete at a high level and showcase their talent. The event is organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: Athletics disciplines for boys and girls under 18
Discus and hammer events at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad
Held at the National Stadium "Vasil Levski"
additional: Location: Pravets; disciplines: long jump and triple jump; date: July 25, 2026

description: The first national road running championship in Bulgaria will be held in Plovdiv on August 1, 2026. The competition includes distances of 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon, as well as starts for children and beginners. The event is part of the "Run Bulgaria" series and offers a prize fund of over 4000 BGN. This is an important opportunity for amateurs and professionals to compete on attractive courses and prepare for European and World Championships.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 mile (1609 m), 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon 21.1 km
The race takes place in Plovdiv, one of the major cities in Bulgaria
Includes starts for children and beginners at 1 km
additional: The mass 1 km run is free for everyone. Before the championship, there will be activities in Children's Athletics and a press conference with awards for the best runners of 2024. The event is part of the "Run Bulgaria" series and serves as preparation for the European road running championship. Distances: 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, 1 km for children and beginners; online registration; fee of 40 BGN for some distances; free mass start for 1 km.

name: С ухание на малини и боровинки Run
description: With the scent of raspberries and blueberries, Run is an exciting Trail Run competition held in Northwestern Bulgaria, in the area of Midzhur Hut and Kopren Hut. Participants can choose between different routes with varying difficulty and technical elements, running amidst stunning mountain views. The race offers adrenaline, new friendships, and a sense of achievement on each trail. Organizers recommend using trail running shoes and remind that the event may be canceled in adverse weather conditions.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with varying difficulty and technical elements
Breathtaking views in Northwestern Bulgaria between the Iskar and Timoch rivers
Opportunity to summit peaks and run in nature
additional: Reservation must be made at least one week before the chosen date. The races do not include transportation to the venue. Participants are required to use specialized trail running shoes. The voucher is valid for one participant. The event may be canceled in bad weather conditions. Information about the course, registration, and participation conditions is not available; the event is part of trail running in Northwestern Bulgaria.

name: Славееви Планини Ултра

description: Slavyanski Mountains Ultra 2026 is a trail running and mountain biking event held in the vicinity of the town of Dospat in the Rhodope Mountains. The event offers various distances from 9 to 56 km with different levels of difficulty and elevation gain up to 2900 meters. Participants can enjoy picturesque forests, panoramic views, and clean air, combining sport, adventure, and love for the mountain. The start and finish are in the town center, and the race is suitable for both advanced runners and cyclists, as well as enthusiasts seeking new challenges.
course_highlights: Distances from 9 to 56 km with elevation gain up to 2900 m
Trail through picturesque forests and panoramic views
Start and finish in the center of Dospat
additional: The starter pack includes a medal, a souvenir with the event logo, timing, a race number, trail marking, photo coverage, and refreshment points. It does not include additional or mandatory equipment. Registration with lower fees until April 30, 2026, 23:59:59, payment by May 2 at 12:00. Early registration fees include medals, starter packs, and refreshment points.

name: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare
description: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare is an event from the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in Chepelare, Western Rhodopes. The start and finish are at "Olympic" Square at an altitude of 1,062 meters. The routes pass through Rhodope forests, mountain meadows, and panoramic mountain trails with a maximum elevation of 1,872 meters. Participants can choose between three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking.
course_highlights: The routes pass through Rhodope forests and mountain meadows
Panoramic mountain trails with a maximum elevation of 1,872 meters
Three distances with ascent up to +1,887 meters and descent up to −1,885 meters
additional: Free parking opens at 05:00 at SOU "Vasil Dechev". Registration and distribution of start packages are from 6:30 to 8:00 at "Olympic" Square, with the possibility of paying on site via Revolut, PayPal, or ePay. Starts for mountain biking and running are divided by distances and begin between 8:30 and 9:30. There is a children's run and a children's program with yoga, games, and cake. Awards for children and all distances are scheduled for the afternoon hours. The event includes various distances and participation packages, with the start for mountain biking scheduled for 08:30 on August 1, 2026.

description: Balkaniada West is a mountain race taking place on August 2, 2026, starting at 06:00 AM. The race includes several distances of varying lengths and positive elevation gain, with routes passing through scenic mountain areas around the Gorski Ray hut. The event has a limited number of participants and requires prior approval of registration applications. Organizers provide transportation, overnight stays, food, and branded clothing for those who finish within the control time.
course_highlights: Vertical Kilometer: 3.8 km with 830 m positive elevation gain
Distances: 12 km / 700 m D+, 27 km / 1900 m D+, 44 km / 2570 m D+
Prologue of 10 km with 900 m positive elevation gain from Chuprene village to Gorski Ray hut (no time tracking)
additional: The race is limited to 30 participants (for the first edition). You must have completed races with control times from 2025 or provide evidence of similar achievements. Organized transportation is available from Sofia to Kom hut and from Kom hut to Chuprene village. Accommodation, dinner, and breakfast are included at the Kom and Gorski Ray huts. Every finisher receives branded clothing. The event includes a prologue, organized transportation, overnight stays, breakfasts, and branded clothing for finishers. Participation is limited to 30, with selection based on experience.

name: RILA RUN
description: Ride Or Run - Rila is a popular and unconventional race held in the Rila Mountains, starting from the village of Pastra and ending at the Kalin Dam. The course is 15.3 km of ascent along a high mountain road with a positive elevation gain of over 1800 meters. The event attracts both cyclists and runners who face a serious challenge in mountain conditions. After a few years of pause, the event again gathers the best athletes in this discipline.
course_highlights: 15.3 km ascent along a high mountain road
Positive elevation gain over 1800 meters
Course from Pastra village to Kalin Dam in the Rila Mountains
additional: The course is 15.3 km with ascent along a high mountain road, includes support points at 5, 10, and 15.3 km, and offers races in running, cycling, and duathlon.

name: Мусала Екстрийм
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race held in Borovets, offering two distances - 38 km with 2200 meters of elevation gain and 16 km with 1000 meters of elevation gain. The course passes through peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Ludmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, providing stunning views of Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and the Balkan Mountains. The race combines technically difficult sections with fast descents and requires strength, speed, and skills. In addition to individual competitions, there is a team run, as well as a duathlon with cycling the following day.
course_highlights: 38 km with 2200 meters of elevation through peaks Yastrebets, Aleko, Musala, and Mancho
16 km Yastrebets Trail Run with 1000 meters of elevation on a marked trail
Technical rocky and steep sections with panoramic views of Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and the Balkan Mountains
additional: Start and finish at the slope in front of Rila Hotel. Distribution of race packets the evening before the race and on the morning of the start. Award ceremony for the winners at 11:00 for Yastrebets Trail Run and at 15:00 for Musala Extreme. Opportunity to participate in a team run with no participant limit per team. Duathlon with cycling the next day along the Lakatska Rila route. The course includes technical sections requiring mountain running skills; registration and participation fee; mandatory equipment; options for shorter distances and team runs; duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: Musala Extreme
organizer: Клуб за изкуство и спорт "Дунавска" / Borosport
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race in Borovets, Bulgaria, with a distance of 38 km and 2200 meters of elevation gain. The course passes through peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina. The race requires technical skills to navigate rocky and steep sections, combining strength, speed, and attention. A shorter race, Yastrebets Trail Run, with a distance of 16 km and 1000 meters of elevation gain, is held simultaneously, suitable for runners seeking an easier route. Organizers also offer team running and a duathlon with cycling the following day.
course_highlights: 38 km with 2200 m elevation gain through peaks Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho
Technical rocky and steep sections requiring skills and attention
Panoramic views of Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina
additional: Start and finish at the track in front of Rila Hotel. Distribution of race packets the evening before the race and on the morning of the start. Awards ceremony after each race distance. Opportunity to participate in team running and a duathlon with cycling the next day. The course is 38 km long with 2200 meters of elevation gain, including ascent to Musala Peak and passing through mountain shelters and trails. Registration deadline is August 10. The race supports initiatives for vegetation restoration.

name: XL kmrun - с. Кътина
description: XL Kŭtina is a mountain running race, part of the XLkmrun series, held in the area of Kŭtina village, Sofia. The race offers three distances of varying lengths suitable for different levels of preparation. The routes pass through natural trails and cart roads, providing a challenge and beautiful scenery. The event is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park runs in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: Mountain running in the area of Kŭtina village
Three distances: 4.8 km, 9.6 km, and 14.4 km
Routes on natural trails and cart roads
additional: The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park runs in Sofia and other cities. Each event offers a choice of several distances. Results and photos from previous editions are available on the website. There is no specific information about start times, fees, or participant caps. The event includes three distances and takes place in August 2026.

name: Хисаря рън
description: Hisarya Run is an annual race that attracts runners of various ages and levels. The course starts and finishes at the modern 'Krepost' stadium and passes by the preserved Roman fortress wall and two beautiful parks in Hisarya. The event offers two main distances - 7.85 km for more experienced runners and 1.6 km, suitable for children and youth. The event is part of RUN BULGARIA and combines sport with cultural and historical attractions of the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at 'Krepost' stadium
The course passes by the Roman fortress wall
Passes through two beautiful parks in Hisarya
additional: The race includes both professional athletes and children and youth. There are also lectures and an academy for children related to athletics. The event is part of the larger initiative RUN BULGARIA. The dates for the next races are August 16, 2026, as part of the RUN BULGARIA series, with prizes for the winners and participation opportunities for all ages.

name: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra
description: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra is one of the leading trail running races in Bulgaria, held every summer in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains. The event attracts runners from around the world who can enjoy the unique spirit, culture, and natural beauty of this ancient mountain region. The 50-kilometer course passes through the wildest and most beautiful corners of the mountain, including the Wonder Bridges, the Chimneys, and the Cirikova Church, offering a challenge and unforgettable views.
course_highlights: 50 kilometers through the heart of the Rhodopes
Passing through the Wonder Bridges and the Chimneys
The route includes Cirikova Church and wild natural beauty
additional: The race is a benchmark for wilderness and natural beauty, combining sport and culture in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: Adventure Sky Run
description: Adventure SkyRun is a mountain race held since 2016 in the Rila Mountains, offering three distances with varying difficulty and length. The routes pass through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Lakes Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest trail, a 25 km ski track, and a challenging 55 km run connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa. The race offers stunning natural views and the opportunity to surpass one's own limits.
course_highlights: 12 km forest trail through ancient Rila pine forests
25 km single track with ascent to Zeleni Preslap and panoramic views of the Rila Lakes
55 km route connecting Borovets and Malyovitsa resorts with ascent to Musala Peak and passing through Ribni Lakes and Strashnoto Lake
additional: Start packages are distributed on August 28, 2026, from 13:00 to 20:00 at Rila Hotel, Borovets Resort, and on the morning of August 29, 2026, before the start.
